page.overview:
Who is Castle Staff?

The Blue Candy can be seen at the end of the row, at the left. It is unknown what kind of candy he is.

The Blue Gumball is seen in between the Wafer and the Upside-Down Ice Cream Cone. He has shiny, light-blue skin, wears a hat, and wears boots. Both the hat and boots are green. His eyes are white.

The Jelly Roll is seen in between the Red Ice Cream Sandwich and the Wafer. He is very short, and has white frosting all over his body. Jelly can be seen on the side of his body as red swirls. He has white eyes.

A Marshmallow is a member who appeared standing next to the Upside-down Ice Cream Cone. It looks like a marshmallow kid, and likely is one of them. It is white and appears to have been slightly melted. Its eyes are also white.
